# viettelcloud_placement_group (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Placement Group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "region" {
  type        = string
  description = "Project region used by the Placement Group."
  default     = "vn-central"
}

variable "replacement_region" {
  type        = string
  description = "Project region used to demonstrate replacement when the region attribute changes."
  default     = "vn-central"
}

resource "viettelcloud_placement_group" "example" {
  name        = "my-placement-group"
  description = "Example placement group"
  policy      = "affinity"
  region = {
    name = var.region
  }
}

# Changing region forces a new Placement Group.
resource "viettelcloud_placement_group" "replacement" {
  name        = "my-placement-group-replacement"
  description = "Replacement placement group after region change"
  policy      = "affinity"
  region = {
    name = var.replacement_region
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Placement Group.
- `policy` (String) Placement Group policy: one of affinity, anti-affinity, soft-affinity, or soft-anti-affinity. Changing the policy replaces the Placement Group.
- `region` (Attributes) Project region where the Placement Group is created. Changing the region replaces the Placement Group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the Placement Group. Omitting it preserves the backend value; set it to an empty string to clear it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Placement Group was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Placement Group ID (UUID).
- `project` (String) Project name owning the Placement Group.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID) backing the configured region.
- `server_count` (Number) Number of servers currently assigned to the Placement Group.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Placement Group was last updated (RFC3339).
